text:
Code: GokuNEmu GitHub
Package: PyPI
Paper: arXiv:2507.07177
Related GP version: GokuEmu GitHub, arXiv:2501.06296
Supports \(N_\mathrm{eff} \alpha_s \nu w_0 w_a \mathrm{CDM}\) cosmologies.
In the Goku simulations, neutrino masses are assumed to follow the normal hierarchy, rather than three degenerate masses as in many other emulators. For small total masses (\(\Sigma m_\nu \lesssim 0.2\,\mathrm{eV}\)), this difference leads to small but non-negligible deviations, which should be taken into account when comparing results.
\(N_\mathrm{eff}\) and \(\alpha_s\) are also input parameters; because DE2 does not vary them, they are fixed at \(N_\mathrm{eff}=3.044\) and \(\alpha_s=0\).

This website provides supplementary material for the emulator-comparison analysis in the DarkEmulator2 paper. The materials are intended to document the calculations underlying the comparison section of the paper and to provide additional diagnostic plots that are not included in the main text.

title: GokuNEmu: \(P_\mathrm{lin,tot}\)
text:
Code: GokuNEmu GitHub
Package: PyPI
Paper: arXiv:2507.07177
Related GP version: GokuEmu GitHub, arXiv:2501.06296
Supports \(N_\mathrm{eff} \alpha_s \nu w_0 w_a \mathrm{CDM}\) cosmologies.
In the Goku simulations, neutrino masses are assumed to follow the normal hierarchy, rather than three degenerate masses as in many other emulators. For small total masses (\(\Sigma m_\nu \lesssim 0.2\,\mathrm{eV}\)), this difference leads to small but non-negligible deviations, which should be taken into account when comparing results.
\(N_\mathrm{eff}\) and \(\alpha_s\) are also input parameters; because DE2 does not vary them, they are fixed at \(N_\mathrm{eff}=3.044\) and \(\alpha_s=0\).
